verdict.rationale: Dover's built-in reporting covers most of the funnel. Funnel Conversion gives per-job stage-to-stage percentages through the offer stage to hires, Time to Hire gives per-job days per stage and per hire, and Hires by Source breaks hires down by source. Offer-accept rate is only implied by the offer-to-hire conversion step, and nothing shows a per-team view. missing for 10: explicit offer-accept rate metric, per-team breakdowns, source effectiveness beyond hire counts (e.g. conversion by source), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: For one job, how many candidates reached each interview and offer stage, and the percent that moved on from the previous stage, ending with hires.

For one job, the average days candidates spent in each interview and offer stage before moving on, plus a table of every hire with the hire date, days in each stage, and days from when the job was created.
Hires by where the candidate was found, such as LinkedIn, Indeed, or an agency.
